mainEntity.name: Is this white compression shirt see-through?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opacity depends on fabric selection, fit, stretch, lighting and moisture. Approve a physical sample in dry and damp conditions, including full movement and body-contour checks. The photographs do not establish a zero-transparency guarantee.
The supplied development brief specifies 85% polyester / 15% spandex and a target range of 220–250 GSM. Confirm one exact weight, finish and fabric record before bulk production.

mainEntity.name: Will the seams chafe during BJJ or gym training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flat seams are intended to reduce raised contact points. Check the underarm and side seams against the skin during movement; comfort depends on fit and finishing. Zero chafing is not a tested guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Will the collar stretch out or the hem roll up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check neckline recovery and hem position during overhead reaches, bends and repeated washing. Approve the binding, hem length and stitching on the sample; this reference does not establish an anti-roll or anti-deformation test result.

mainEntity.name: Can I order private label rash guards with my logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Discuss chest and nape artwork, labels, fit and packaging for your OEM/ODM compression shirt project. Selected projects start at 10 pieces; confirm the minimum per style, design and colorway.

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a size?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied model reference is 5 ft 11 in (180 cm), 195 lb (88 kg), chest 42 in (about 107 cm), wearing MD. Approve actual garment chest, body length, sleeve measurements and tolerances; request a looser fit if needed.

mainEntity.name: Is the video a fabric performance test?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a supplied promotional overview. Its stretch demonstration does not measure elastic recovery, opacity, wash durability, compression pressure or recovery benefits.
